request.state: A source-based system generates application callables and reusable packages. Localized message declarations own their source language, parameter types and variants. The selected invoking application owns a declared default locale after composition conflict checking; imported packages do not set that default. Canonical invocation admission already supplies a verified team timezone, or a null team. The generated handlers receive a separate context for caller/storage/query/clock; it currently forwards neither application default nor admitted timezone. Nested reusable derives pass that handler context unchanged. A public two-argument formatter already accepts normalized descriptors plus explicit locale, app default, source language and timezone, and returns text plus locale provenance. Preserve this formatter API and exact numeric/temporal values. Add the complete selected-app metadata and trusted context join without viewer-locale substitution, package-static defaults, or silent missing-host fallback. Old protocol support must refuse unsupported generated requirements explicitly.

format_context.instructions: Which complete carrier meets these identical semantics with the smallest reliable ownership and maintenance burden? Compare all required consumers fairly.

criteria.handler_scope: Add immutable formatting inputs to the existing executable handler context, populated only from checked selected-app metadata and admitted team timezone. Migrate canonical/direct/occurrence handler constructors, generated adapter and compatibility requirements; nested context forwarding stays unchanged. Keep admission receipt identity and public formatter unchanged. Missing qualified scope fails loudly.
criteria.canonical_context: Add app default to the canonical admitted invocation context alongside existing team timezone, then explicitly forward a formatting view to executable handlers. Migrate shared canonical contracts, admission constructors/fixtures and every handler/occurrence entry plus generated adapter/compatibility. This offers one broader trusted carrier but changes more shared APIs; caller/store/query context remains separate.
criteria.bound_factory: Bind selected-app formatting configuration into generated callable factories, passing admitted timezone per invocation. Migrate the current zero-argument factory convention and every loader/dispatcher/testkit/occurrence constructor to bind the selected app consistently, including shared packages and compatibility. Preserve canonical receipt and public formatter, but change all callable factory consumers.
